title: Rare Beauty Brands reveals three winners of 2026 LIFT Beauty Accelerator
summary: Beauty brand Ashunta Sheriff Beauty, Beame and GNTL will receive $10,000 each as well as mentorship and in-kind services through the programme, plus the opportunity to pitch US retailer and partner of the initiative, JCPenney
